question_types_in_exam.summary: RBSE Class 12 Economics paper mein 23 questions hain. Q1 = 12 MCQ (12 marks). Q2 = 6 Fill in Blanks (6 marks). Q3 = 12 Very Short (10-20 words, 1 mark each = 12 marks). Q4-Q16 = Short Answer (30-40 words, 2 marks each = 26 marks). Q17-Q20 = Medium Answer (60-80 words, 3 marks each = 12 marks). Q21-Q23 = Long Answer (100-150 words, 4 marks each = 12 marks). Total = 80 marks.

key_numericals_to_practice.formula: NNP_FC = GNP_MP - Depreciation - Indirect Taxes + Subsidies
GVA = Value of Output - Intermediate Consumption
Ed = (% change in Quantity Demanded) / (% change in Price)
Es = (% change in Quantity Supplied) / (% change in Price)
Set qD = qS and solve for p, then substitute back
Revenue Deficit = Revenue Expenditure - Revenue Receipts
Trade Balance = Exports - Imports; Current Account Balance = Trade Balance + Invisibles
key_numericals_to_practice.example: Export=2400, Import=1500, Invisibles=520 → Trade Balance=900, Current Account=1420 million USD

key_numericals_to_practice.topic: TR and MR in Perfect Competition
key_numericals_to_practice.formula: TR = Price x Quantity; MR = TRn - TRn-1 (= Price always in perfect competition)

tips: Q1-Q3 mein 30 marks hain — ye sabse zyaada scoring section hai. Carefully attempt karo.
Q17 se Q23 mein OR choice milti hai — dono options padhkar aasaan wala choose karo.
Numericals mein formula pehle likho, phir values substitute karo, phir answer — step-by-step se partial marks milte hain.
Diagrams mein axes label karo, curves clearly draw karo, important points mark karo.
Section B (Q4-Q16) mein 2-mark questions hain — concise 2-point answers do. Zyaada mat likho.
RBI = Central Bank = currency issue + lender of last resort — ye MCQ guaranteed hai.
TC - TVC = TFC, LAC-LMC minimum par milte hain — ye MCQ repeat hote hain.
GDP expenditure method: C+I+G+(X-M) — formula pakka yaad karo.
Roll number aur question number pehle likhna mat bhoolna.
Long answers mein word limit 100-150 words — count karke rakho.

time_allocation.note: 15 min — carefully padhke attempt karo. Eliminate wrong options.
20 min — Q2 aur Q3 ke sab 18 sub-questions. Quick factual answers.
40 min — 3 min per question. 2 clear points + numericals mein formula.
25 min — 6-7 min per question. Diagrams Q19-Q20 mein clearly banao.
30 min — 10 min each. Structured points + labeled diagrams.
5 min — roll number, question numbers, word limits check karo
